items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Me, Chris Bond, and Peter Burkage. Opened that place up.

ctx.x: Well, all I know is Pete Lawler's band. They work at the cabaret. Did that happen? The British Christian. What was the name of the band, one of the Pete Lawler's band, wasn't it? That's all right. Sure, sure. Yeah, we're at the cabaret, you know what I mean. Yeah, the cabaret's over at the band. They're hard to different men, you see? Yeah.
I, uh, the bass on violin, and me on the carinet, boy, Chris on the piano, and the drums. All right. And bass. Yeah, you had no bass. You had a bass in that.
Five, five pieces. Didn't have no bass regular, but in that picture you got a bass. That ball game or something y'all played. Y'all used to play that ball game, do you know? Mm-hmm.
